description: This file implements the DeviceAudioCapabilities class, which provides methods to query supported audio ports and capabilities on a device, including MS12 profiles and audio capabilities, and initializes relevant device managers.

classes.name: DeviceAudioCapabilities
classes.description: A class that manages querying device audio capabilities, including supported ports, capabilities, MS12 profiles, and MS12 capabilities.

methods.name: SupportedAudioPorts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of supported audio output ports on the device.

methods.name: AudioCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the audio capabilities supported on a specific audio port.

methods.name: MS12Capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves MS12 capabilities supported on a specific audio port.

methods.name: SupportedMS12AudioProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves supported MS12 audio profiles for a given audio port.
